GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2015-10-26T04:51:26Z

Title: Unit testing support for <include> documentation elements
Description: I'm having trouble writing a unit test that includes a documentation comment containing an `<include>` element. I tried using `AddAdditionalDocument` to add the included file to the workspace, and I also tried writing the file to disk. In both cases, the expanded documentation simply included a comment saying the `<include>` element could not be expanded. See sharwell/StyleCopAnalyzers@93749a8 for an example.

:question: Does the `AdhocWorkspace` support resolving `<include>` elements in a documentation comment? If so, where do I place the included file such that it will be located?

:memo: This is part of my work to resolve DotNetAnalyzers/StyleCopAnalyzers#1603.
